notes: Only assigned unfinished fields inspected for completion; all other values are unassigned placeholders. Canonical title and authors match Van Lange et al. (1997). No PDF supplied. Description requests prosocials versus competitors in sample 2, but Study 3 supplies a three-group omnibus and a contrast of prosocials versus pooled individualists and competitors; no identified sample-2 pairwise prosocial-versus-competitor critical test. Candidate pooled contrast prints F(1, 535) = 9.14 and p < .005.
